en: A tinted early-20th‑century street view postcard showing a wide unpaved road lined with single‑storey buildings and leafless trees. Several men and boys in dark clothing stand or walk along the street. Utility poles run down the center, and fields/gardens extend on the right. Printed Hungarian captions and a handwritten message occupy the lower portion of the card.
